title: 115 batshit stupid things you can put on the internet in as fast as I can go  by Dan Tentler
summary: Dan Tentler shows a rapid-fire tour of insecure things found on the open internet using Shodan and his own scanning, from unprotected VNC endpoints to industrial controls. The emphasis is on how little security was considered before connecting them.
why: HN points to it as an entertaining, jaw-dropping demonstration of exposed systems, including a French dam's controls.

quote.text: for complete madness and awe I recommend to watch this one
